name: Q4 Enterprise Voice AI Questionnaire
description: Voice survey for assessing enterprise interest in autonomous sales outreach

questions.text: How many SDRs or outbound sales reps does your organization employ?
questions.aiPrompt: To start off, approximately how many SDRs or sales reps are on your outbound team today?

questions.text: What is your main challenge with phone sales qualification?
questions.aiPrompt: What would you say is the biggest headache with phone sales qualification right now?

questions.text: How likely are you to run an AI voice pilot within the next 30 days?
questions.aiPrompt: On a scale from 1 to 5, how likely are you to test an AI voice pilot over the next month?
